newsitem.title: EGYPT: Four killed when Egypt factory chimney collapses.
newsitem.headline: Four killed when Egypt factory chimney collapses.

text.p: The owner of an Egyptian brick factory drowned in 30 tonnes of diesel fuel when the factory chimney collapsed on top of his office, the government newspaper al-Akhbar said on Wednesday. Three of his workers also died.
The accident took place on Tuesday near the Nile Delta town of Zifta, 80 km (50 miles) north of Cairo, it said. The factory office was built on top of the tank holding fuel for the kiln.
If the chimney had collapsed later in the day, more than 100 workers might have been killed or injured, it added.
